walkIn.description: Assist the person with their consent. No email address or online account is required.
walkIn.checkFieldsHelp: Correct the highlighted fields, then try again.
walkIn.notFound: This draft cannot be found or can no longer be edited.
walkIn.saveError: The server refused to save the file. Try again.
walkIn.networkError: The server could not be reached. Check the connection, then try again.
walkIn.emailHelp: Without an email, the household is served only at the counter and gets no online access.
walkIn.identityHelp: Nothing about the ID is stored.
walkIn.identityRequired: Check the photo ID in person before continuing.
walkIn.nameError: Use letters, spaces, apostrophes or hyphens.
walkIn.birthRange: Enter a date of birth within the last 120 years, not in the future.
walkIn.holderAge: The account holder must be 18 or older.
walkIn.streetNumberError: Enter a valid street number, for example 1234 or 1234A.
walkIn.tooManyPeople: Add at most 14 people besides the account holder.
walkIn.maxPeople: Maximum of 15 people reached, account holder included.
walkIn.noEmail: No email: served at the counter only
walkIn.draftSavedDescription: {{name}}'s registration has not been submitted yet.
walkIn.todoIdentity: Check the photo ID in person
walkIn.todoNotices: Notices of assessment and approval (next step)
walkIn.consentHelp: Read the notice aloud; the person agrees verbally. The time and the text version are saved.
walkIn.consentRequired: Read the notice aloud and record the person's consent before continuing.
walkIn.todoConsent: Read the notice aloud and record consent

walkInNotices.title: Notices of assessment
walkInNotices.description: One card per adult in {{name}}'s household. Photograph the notice or choose a file, then type the values from the notice.
walkInNotices.notDraft: This file is no longer a draft: notices can only be recorded on a draft.
walkInNotices.noAdults: This household has no adult. Add the people 18 or older first.
walkInNotices.didNotFile: This person did not file a tax return
walkInNotices.didNotFileHelp: The file will go to review.
walkInNotices.takePhoto: Take a photo of the notice
walkInNotices.seenHelp: Tick only if you held the original notice.
walkInNotices.dateAfterYear: The notice date comes after December 31, {{year}}.
walkInNotices.notReady: Every adult needs a notice or a reason for not filing before a decision.
walkInNotices.finishReplacing: Save or cancel the notice being replaced before the decision.
walkInNotices.ready: Every adult has a notice seen in person. The file is ready for a decision.
walkInNotices.review: A reason for not filing or a notice not seen in person sends the file to review.
walkInNotices.approveHelp: Eligibility decides: the file is approved, rejected or sent to review.
walkInNotices.approvedHelp: If the household gave an email, they will receive a link to create their account.
walkInNotices.reasonIncomeAboveLico: Total income is above the low-income cut-off for this household size.
walkInNotices.reasonNameMismatch: The name on a notice does not match the member.
walkInNotices.reasonAddressMismatch: The postal code on a notice does not match the address.
walkInNotices.reasonNoticeNotSeen: A notice was not seen in person.
walkInNotices.reasonDidNotFile: An adult did not file a tax return.
walkInNotices.reasonTaxYear: A notice is for a tax year that is not accepted.
walkInNotices.reasonIdentity: Photo ID was not checked in person.
walkInNotices.reasonReview: The file was already waiting for review.

search.description: Search by household ID, staff user ID, or date (Montreal time).
search.invalidRange: The end date must not be before the start date.
